name: Rail Madad Integrated Helpline (139)
beneficiary: Train passengers and railway station visitors across India
benefits: Unified assistance for emergency security (RPF/GRP), medical aid, cleanliness, and travel enquiries
eligibility: Any passenger travelling on or visiting Indian Railways network
required_documents: PNR Number or Train/Coach details (for onboard grievances)
application_process: Dial 139, send SMS to 139, or submit a request via RailMadad portal/app.
